name: add_question
description:
Adds a Question (red card) to a story during a Three Amigos session.

Use when neither the agent nor the PM can answer something in the
moment — park it, don't let it derail the conversation. Open
questions count against the readiness gate (`scenarios > questions`);
call `resolve_question` when the answer is found.

text.description: The open question in plain language (e.g., 'Does suspension affect mid-transaction cards or only new transactions?'). 1–2000 characters.

name: add_rule
description:
Adds a Rule (blue card) to a story during a Three Amigos session.

Rejects when the target story has no personas linked — Three Amigos
enforces persona linkage before any rules or scenarios can land. The
agent should call `create_persona` (and `link_persona_to_story` if
needed) before retrying.

statement.description: The rule statement in business terms (e.g., 'Suspended cards cannot be used for purchases'). 1–1000 characters.

name: add_scenario
description:
Adds a Scenario (green card) to a story during a Three Amigos session.

Each scenario is a Criterion record carrying both the title (one-line
description in domain terms) and the Given/When/Then body (plain
Gherkin), linked to a Rule via `rule_id`. Rules and scenarios are
created together as a single atom — there is no two-stage "title now,
body later" split.

The scenario's `kind` distinguishes happy-path from failure-path
coverage. `kind` is metadata for UI grouping and Gherkin rendering;
the readiness gate only requires ≥1 scenario per rule of any kind.

body.description: Plain-text Gherkin Given/When/Then body for the scenario.

kind.description: `happy_path` or `failure_path`. Use `happy_path` for the normal flow; add `failure_path` only when a genuine failure surface exists for this rule.

rule_statement.description: The exact statement of the Rule this scenario illustrates. The Rule must already exist on the story.

title.description: Scenario title (one-line, in domain language; names the persona with relevant context).

name: delete_rule
description:
Deletes a Rule (blue card) from a Three Amigos story. Cascade-removes any
linked scenarios (Criteria linked via `rule_id`) in the same transaction.
Use this for PM-side cleanup of bogus or superseded rules.

rule_id.description: UUID of the rule to delete.

name: get_story_gherkin
description:
Renders a story's Three Amigos artifacts as a plain-text Gherkin
`.feature` document.

The DB is the source of truth; this tool assembles the view on demand.
Used by downstream consumers (SexySpex generation, the local web UI's
feature preview, codegen) — none of which read a `.feature` file from
disk.

name: list_questions
description:
Lists every Question on a given story (open, resolved, and deferred),
ordered by insertion time (oldest first).

name: list_rules
description:
Lists every Rule on a given story, ordered by insertion time
(oldest first).

name: resolve_question
description:
Marks a Question (red card) as resolved.

Once resolved, the question no longer counts against the readiness
gate's `scenarios > questions` clause — the record stays for
historical context but doesn't block the session.

question_id.description: UUID of the question to resolve.

resolution.description: The answer that resolved it — recorded on the record, not just that it was settled.

name: update_rule
description:
Updates a Rule's (blue card) statement during a Three Amigos session.
Use this for PM-side wording fixes on an existing rule without
re-creating it or losing its linked scenarios.

rule_id.description: UUID of the rule to update.

statement.description: The new rule statement in business terms (e.g., 'Suspended cards cannot be used for purchases'). 1–1000 characters.

name: update_scenario
description:
Updates an existing Scenario (green card) — the Given/When/Then body,
title, and/or kind. Unlike `add_scenario` this never re-links to a
different rule; use `retire_criterion` + `add_scenario` if the
scenario belongs under a different Rule.

Refuses to edit verified (locked) scenarios — once a criterion has
been marked verified, the wording is part of the audit trail.

body.description: New Given/When/Then body (plain-text Gherkin). Omit to leave unchanged.

criterion_number.description: Criterion number of the scenario to update (from `get_story` or `get_story_gherkin`).

kind.description: New scenario kind — `happy_path` or `failure_path`. Omit to leave unchanged.

title.description: New scenario title (one-line, in domain language). Omit to leave unchanged.
